item.content:encoded: Source: jctabb/Depositphotos Sophie Cunningham’s name has become part of a political conversation that stretches well beyond the WNBA, and Donald Trump’s latest remarks have brought that attention back into focus. The Indiana Fever guard was singled out by the president during an October 12 rally in Youngstown, Ohio, where he praised her appearance while questioning her basketball ability. The remarks renewed attention on Cunningham’s “MAGA Barbie” nickname, a label that has followed her as audiences have debated her political image and interpreted her social media presence and public comments. Cunningham, however, has pushed back against attempts to place her neatly in one political camp. That contrast between her own description of her beliefs and the public image built around her has become another part of her increasingly high-profile WNBA career. Donald Trump’s comments put Cunningham back in the spotlight Trump referred to Cunningham as a “beautiful young woman” during his October 12 appearance in Youngstown. He suggested that her presence could help attract spectators before joking that she would not necessarily help a team score points. The comments immediately shifted attention from Cunningham’s basketball career to her broader public image. Rather than discussing her shooting, defense or role with Indiana, Trump focused largely on her appearance and ability to attract an audience. That attention arrived shortly after Cunningham completed another season with the Fever. Indiana’s 2026 campaign ended with a first-round playoff loss to the Las Vegas Aces, sending Cunningham into an offseason in which her future with the team remains uncertain. Why the ‘MAGA Barbie’ label follows Cunningham The “MAGA Barbie” nickname was circulating before Trump mentioned Cunningham in October. It reflects the way some fans, commentators, and political audiences have interpreted her public image and perceived political leanings. The label has also been fueled by the increasingly political attention surrounding Cunningham outside basketball. Her social media activity and willingness to express her opinions publicly have led people to assume where she stands politically. Cunningham has rejected the idea that those assumptions tell the whole story. She has described herself as “very much in the middle,” saying she agrees with some positions on both sides of the political spectrum and disagrees with others. That makes the nickname more of a reflection of public perception than a formal description of Cunningham’s own political identity. Cunningham has resisted being placed in one political camp Cunningham has acknowledged that people frequently make assumptions about her beliefs. In discussing her politics, she has emphasized that her views do not fit neatly into a single partisan category. Source: galecophoto/Depositphotos That distinction has become increasingly important as her name appears in conversations that extend far beyond basketball. A nickname can spread quickly online, especially when it offers a simple way to describe a public figure, but Cunningham’s own explanation is more complicated than the label suggests. Her situation shows how an athlete’s public identity can take on a life of its own. Once political audiences begin to identify someone with a particular movement or worldview, changing that perception can be difficult, even when the person offers a more nuanced account. Fun fact: Cunningham played college basketball at the University of Missouri, where she became one of the program’s most decorated players and earned multiple All-SEC honors before entering the WNBA. Playing with Caitlin Clark brought an even bigger spotlight Cunningham’s public profile also grew because of her role with the Indiana Fever. Playing alongside Caitlin Clark placed her on one of the WNBA’s most closely watched teams, where individual plays and confrontations regularly generated national attention. One of Cunningham’s most discussed moments came during a heated 2025 game against the Connecticut Sun. Late in the contest, Cunningham committed a hard foul on Jacy Sheldon, triggering another confrontation in a game that had already featured several physical incidents involving Clark and other players. The WNBA assessed Cunningham a flagrant-2 foul, and the sequence quickly spread online. It reinforced her reputation as a physical and emotional competitor willing to play with an edge. Moments like that helped Cunningham become recognizable to fans who may not have followed her closely before. The combination of the Fever’s popularity, Clark’s enormous audience, and Cunningham’s personality gave her a much larger national platform. Her basketball numbers tell another part of the story Political discussions can easily overshadow what Cunningham actually does on the court. During the 2026 regular season, she averaged 7.9 points per game while shooting 41.9% from 3-point range. Her scoring average was not among the league’s highest, but her outside shooting remained an important part of her game. Cunningham also played a supporting role on a Fever roster built around stars who commanded much of the offensive attention. Her value has never depended entirely on scoring. Cunningham has developed a reputation for energy, physical play and competitiveness, qualities that have helped make her one of Indiana’s more recognizable role players. The 2026 postseason ended quickly for the Fever, however. Las Vegas eliminated Indiana in the opening round, bringing Cunningham’s season to an end and shifting attention toward what comes next. Source: galecophoto/Depositphotos Free agency adds another question to Cunningham’s future Cunningham enters the offseason as a free agent, creating uncertainty about whether she will remain with Indiana. That decision matters for more than basketball. Her time with the Fever has dramatically increased her visibility, particularly because of the attention surrounding Clark and the franchise as a whole. Remaining in Indiana would keep Cunningham in one of the league’s highest-profile environments. A move elsewhere could give her a different role while testing how much of her growing audience follows her independently of the Fever. Either way, her 2026 season showed that her public profile now extends considerably beyond box scores. Basketball remains the foundation of her career, but her personality, social media presence, and political image increasingly shape how broader audiences perceive her. Trump’s remarks add another layer to her public image Trump’s October comments demonstrated just how far Cunningham’s name has traveled beyond the WNBA. Being mentioned by a sitting president at a political rally gives an athlete a different kind of exposure, particularly when the remarks focus as much on appearance and celebrity as athletic performance. For Cunningham, the moment also reinforced the gap between how others portray her and how she describes herself. Some audiences continue to associate her with conservative politics and the “MAGA Barbie” nickname, while Cunningham has publicly characterized her own beliefs as much less easily categorized. That tension is likely to remain part of her public image as she moves into free agency. Wherever she plays next, Cunningham enters the offseason with considerably more name recognition than basketball statistics alone would explain. TL;DR Donald Trump praised Sophie Cunningham’s appearance while questioning her basketball contribution at an October 12 rally in Youngstown, Ohio. His comments renewed attention on the “MAGA Barbie” nickname associated with Cunningham’s perceived political image. Cunningham has described her own political views as “very much in the middle.” Playing alongside Caitlin Clark and competing for the Indiana Fever has significantly increased Cunningham’s national visibility. The San Francisco 49ers host the Washington Commanders on Monday Night Football at Levi's Stadium. (Steph Chambers/Getty Images) The San Francisco 49ers have been arguably the NFL's best team through the first five weeks, and Monday Night Football gives them a golden opportunity to take further control of the NFC West. The Niners enter tonight's home matchup against the Washington Commanders with a perfect 5-0 record, and their division rivals helped them out over the weekend. Seattle fell to Denver on Thursday night, while the Rams suffered another disappointing loss against Arizona on Sunday. Now San Francisco has a chance to reach 6-0 and put serious distance between itself and the rest of the division. Brock Purdy has been playing at an MVP-caliber level, throwing 13 touchdowns in five games, and the 49ers have kept winning despite injuries across the roster. Washington, meanwhile, comes into Levi's Stadium at 1-3-1, with quarterback Jayden Daniels in the news recently for the overtime blunder that led to a tie against the Giants. The Commanders are desperate to get their season back on track, but the Niners have home-field advantage, momentum, and a chance to tighten their grip on the NFC West. For Bay Area fans, it's hard to imagine a better way to close out Week 6 than another primetime win. Tonight's Monday Night Football game kicks off at 5:15 p.m. PDT, and football fans everywhere can catch the action on Sling TV . Tonight's matchup is being simulcast on ESPN and ABC, so you can even pick up the broadcast with a 4K antenna from Amazon if your local ABC station comes in clearly. But if you want to stream the game, Sling is our top choice. With both channels airing tonight's game, every Sling package offers a way to watch. Sling Essentials and Orange carry ESPN, while Select and Blue include ABC in eligible markets. Sling Essentials is the cheapest option for tonight's game, starting at just $19.99/month. Select is similarly affordable if you have local ABC access, while Blue offers more channels, and Orange & Blue provides Sling's most complete package. item.title: Man United’s Diogo Dalot leaves every Premier League defender trailing in remarkable statistic
item.description: Man United’s Diogo Dalot leaves every Premier League defender trailing in remarkable statistic Manchester United star Diogo Dalot has emerged as the standout defender in the Premier League in one remarkable statistic. Dalot’s progress Amid United’s miserable start to the season, Dalot, like so many of his teammates, finds himself stuck in a desperately poor patch of form. Dalot has been in and out of the starting XI in the 10 games United have played so far across all competitions. He has primarily been used in his preferred right-back position, but Michael Carrick deployed him on the left during Sunday’s 1-1 draw with Leeds United at Elland Road. Carrick made tactical changes, deploying Dalot higher up as a left wing-back in an attempt to drag Manchester United out of their pitiful slump in performances and results. Although Dalot was solid defensively, his overall performance remained imperfect, with some elements leaving much to be desired. It was in attack where he fell short most of all, with United missing the thrust from his flank that Amad supplied on the other side. A new statistic has nevertheless suggested that Dalot may actually be one of the most creative defenders in the league. Dalot tops stat According to WhoScored, Dalot has created more chances (14) than any other defender in the Premier League this season. Although the statistic will provide encouragement to Dalot and the fans, it is clear that further effort is required if he is to earn complete trust and establish himself as an assured fixture. Dalot and his teammates are next in action on Wednesday when they face Como in the Champions League. Nothing short of a victory will relieve pressure on Carrick and his players. Carrick still retains the backing of the United board, but a loss would certainly put that faith to the test. Featured image by Stu Forster via Getty Images

item.title: O.J. Simpson’s Lawyer Urges Skeptics To Stop The Murder Speculations As Major Twist In The 1994 Case Surfaces
item.description: O.J. Simpson ‘s former attorney, Malcolm LaVergne, is urging the public to move beyond renewed speculation surrounding the 1994 murders of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ron Goldman. His appeal follows fresh allegations suggesting that someone connected to the late NFL star may have helped conceal evidence after the killings. However, O.J. Simpson’s lawyer believes revisiting decades-old theories could cause further distress to the victims’ families. O.J. Simpson’s Lawyer Urges Public To Put An End To Murder Speculation MEGA Malcolm LaVergne has called for an end to the continuing theories surrounding O.J. Simpson ’s connection to the murders of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ron Goldman, arguing that further speculation may only deepen the pain experienced by their families. According to TMZ , the attorney responded to a recent New York Times investigation examining whether someone associated with Simpson could have helped conceal evidence following the June 1994 killings. The report introduced fresh questions about a possible accomplice and the whereabouts of potential evidence. The investigation centered on Joseph “Joey” Ippolito, a convicted drug trafficker who had connections to Simpson. Ippolito’s brother claimed that he returned home on the night of the murders carrying a heavy bag, with blood visible on his hands. His brother also alleged that he subsequently disposed of the bag in a dumpster. These claims have not been proven. Although LaVergne acknowledged the public’s enduring interest in the case, he questioned whether reopening such discussions would accomplish anything constructive. He emphasized that Simpson, Nicole, and Goldman are all deceased, leaving none of them able to provide their own accounts of what occurred. The attorney also stressed that he could not speak on behalf of those involved. In his view, repeatedly examining unverified accusations risks prolonging the suffering of surviving relatives rather than helping them find closure. Malcolm LaVergne Prioritizes Settling O.J. Simpson’s Estate ©2001 RAMEY PHOTO / MEGA Rather than become involved in another round of speculation, Malcolm LaVergne is directing his attention toward resolving the financial and legal matters surrounding O.J. Simpson’s estate. As reported by TMZ , LaVergne, who serves as the estate’s executor, is working to address outstanding claims from creditors. Among those seeking compensation is Fred Goldman, whose son Ron was killed alongside Nicole Brown Simpson in 1994. The attorney indicated that he would prefer to devote his efforts to accomplishing something beneficial for Fred instead of debating new theories about the murders. His responsibilities include overseeing the estate’s administration and determining how available assets can be used to satisfy legitimate financial obligations. item.content:encoded: O.J. Simpson ‘s former attorney, Malcolm LaVergne, is urging the public to move beyond renewed speculation surrounding the 1994 murders of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ron Goldman. His appeal follows fresh allegations suggesting that someone connected to the late NFL star may have helped conceal evidence after the killings. However, O.J. Simpson’s lawyer believes revisiting decades-old theories could cause further distress to the victims’ families. O.J. Simpson’s Lawyer Urges Public To Put An End To Murder Speculation MEGA Malcolm LaVergne has called for an end to the continuing theories surrounding O.J. Simpson ’s connection to the murders of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ron Goldman, arguing that further speculation may only deepen the pain experienced by their families. According to TMZ , the attorney responded to a recent New York Times investigation examining whether someone associated with Simpson could have helped conceal evidence following the June 1994 killings. The report introduced fresh questions about a possible accomplice and the whereabouts of potential evidence. The investigation centered on Joseph “Joey” Ippolito, a convicted drug trafficker who had connections to Simpson. Ippolito’s brother claimed that he returned home on the night of the murders carrying a heavy bag, with blood visible on his hands. His brother also alleged that he subsequently disposed of the bag in a dumpster. These claims have not been proven. Although LaVergne acknowledged the public’s enduring interest in the case, he questioned whether reopening such discussions would accomplish anything constructive. He emphasized that Simpson, Nicole, and Goldman are all deceased, leaving none of them able to provide their own accounts of what occurred. The attorney also stressed that he could not speak on behalf of those involved. In his view, repeatedly examining unverified accusations risks prolonging the suffering of surviving relatives rather than helping them find closure. Malcolm LaVergne Prioritizes Settling O.J. Simpson’s Estate ©2001 RAMEY PHOTO / MEGA Rather than become involved in another round of speculation, Malcolm LaVergne is directing his attention toward resolving the financial and legal matters surrounding O.J. Simpson’s estate. As reported by TMZ , LaVergne, who serves as the estate’s executor, is working to address outstanding claims from creditors. Among those seeking compensation is Fred Goldman, whose son Ron was killed alongside Nicole Brown Simpson in 1994. The attorney indicated that he would prefer to devote his efforts to accomplishing something beneficial for Fred instead of debating new theories about the murders. His responsibilities include overseeing the estate’s administration and determining how available assets can be used to satisfy legitimate financial obligations. Simpson died in April 2024, leaving unresolved obligations that LaVergne has since been tasked with managing. The lawyer hopes that making progress on those matters could provide some measure of resolution for the families, even as questions surrounding the case continue to attract public attention. O.J. Simpson’s true cause of death was revealed two weeks after his passing . Simpson’s family was against donating his brain for CTE research . His former lawyer accused Trump of using Obama to distract from the Epstein files scandal. Simpson’s lawyers revealed the “stupid” mistake Diddy made that cost him his freedom . Simpson assured fans he was in “good” health before his death at age 76. Nicole Brown’s Sister Recalls Chilling Encounter With O.J. Simpson Before Murder MEGA As fresh allegations revive interest in the murder case, Nicole Brown Simpson’s sister, Denise Brown, has shared a disturbing memory of her final hours with Nicole before her death. According to OK! Magazine , Denise recalled attending a family celebration at a restaurant on June 12, 1994. During the gathering, Nicole suddenly noticed her former husband driving past the establishment, prompting a reaction that Denise has never forgotten. “All of a sudden she goes, ‘Oh my God, there he is.’ He was driving by,” Denise recalled. “I saw these headlights, he’s constantly following me,” she said. Despite the unsettling moment, the sisters continued their conversation and discussed plans for the coming summer. The following morning, Denise was awakened by her mother’s cries after the family received the devastating news . “I heard my mom scream a scream that I had never heard from a human being,” she recalled. “It was so guttural. Just awful.” Authorities had informed the family that Nicole and Goldman had been stabbed to death. Denise said her suspicions immediately centered on Simpson because of what she remembered about Nicole’s relationship with him. She has since become an advocate for survivors of domestic violence. In her book, “My Sister Nicole: Love Shouldn’t Hurt,” Denise also reflected on how she wished she had approached her sister’s experiences differently, emphasizing the importance of supporting people facing abuse. O.J. Simpson’s Estate Makes Major Move Toward Paying Goldman Family ZUMAPRESS.com / MEGA The long-standing financial dispute between O.J. Simpson’s estate and Ron Goldman’s family has reached an important development, with the estate formally recognizing a multimillion-dollar creditor claim. According to People Magazine , court documents filed in Nevada on November 14 showed that Malcolm LaVergne accepted a claim of $57,997,858.12, with additional judgment interest still to be determined. Fred Goldman had sought more than $117 million, but LaVergne questioned the accuracy of the interest calculation and indicated that he intended to work toward an agreed figure. The estate’s acknowledgment represents progress in the probate process, although it does not mean the Goldman family has received the money. Their attorney, Michaelle Rafferty, clarified the distinction, stating, “The Executor’s acceptance of the claim is a positive acknowledgment of the debt. It does not constitute payment.” More About O.J. Simpson’s Lawyer’s Move To Settle The Goldman Family MEGA LaVergne told TMZ that the late NFL star’s estate intended to distribute as much money as possible through the sale of Simpson’s possessions. He indicated that efforts were underway to recover items he believed had been taken from the estate, potentially increasing the assets available to creditors. The Goldman family has spent decades attempting to collect the damages awarded after the civil trial, with much of the judgment remaining unpaid during Simpson’s lifetime. Following the former football star’s death, Fred emphasized that financial developments could never outweigh the personal loss. Also Read: O.J. item.title: Fantasy Football Injury Alert: DeMario Douglas & Hunter Henry Become Waiver Wire Targets as Romeo Doubs Heads to IR
item.description: Oct 18, 2026; Foxborough, Massachusetts, USA; New England Patriots tight end Hunter Henry (85) reacts with wide receiver DeMario Douglas (3) after catching a pass for a touchdown during the second half against the New York Jets at Gillette Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Bob DeChiara-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Patriots Injury Fallout: Romeo Doubs to Injured Reserve The New England Patriots received a tough blow to their offense this week, with wide receiver Romeo Doubs landing on injured reserve due to a shoulder injury he suffered in the Patriots Week 6 win against the New York Jets. As the Patriots shuffle their roster, fantasy managers must quickly adapt to how these changes affect target distribution in New England's high-powered attack. The #Patriots placed WR Romeo Doubs (shoulder) on injured reserve and signed DB Elliott Davison to the 53-man roster. Doubs will miss a minimum of four games. Pats lose another starter to IR. - Evan Lazar (@ezlazar) October 19, 2026 With a minimum four-game absence mandated by an injured reserve stint, Doubs is guaranteed to miss time well past the mid-season threshold, putting his earliest potential return around Week 11. For fantasy managers dealing with tight bench space or multiple bye weeks, Doubs can safely be dropped in standard formats. While he carved out a meaningful deep-threat and red-zone role early in the year, losing a month and a half of availability makes him an unnecessary luxury to stash unless you have deep IR slots available. Fantasy Football Implications on Patriots Offense Oct 11, 2026; Foxborough, Massachusetts, USA; New England Patriots tight end Hunter Henry (85) reacts after catching an eleven-yard touchdown pass from quarterback Drake Maye (not pictured) against the Las Vegas Raiders during the second quarter at Lumen Field. Mandatory Credit: David Butler II-Imagn Images TPX IMAGES OF THE DAY | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Two Waiver Wire Priorities Emerge DeMario "Pop" Douglas is the undisputed winner in fantasy football value here, and will become a top Week 7 waiver wire priority for fantasy managers. Operating primarily out of the slot, Douglas is in line for an immediate bump in schemed touches, underneath routes, and third-down looks. He currently leads (or is tied for the lead) on the team in targets and touchdowns, and he should be rostered across all formats immediately. Hunter Henry also stands to pick up substantial intermediate and red-zone work with Doubs out of the picture. item.content:encoded: Oct 18, 2026; Foxborough, Massachusetts, USA; New England Patriots tight end Hunter Henry (85) reacts with wide receiver DeMario Douglas (3) after catching a pass for a touchdown during the second half against the New York Jets at Gillette Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Bob DeChiara-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Patriots Injury Fallout: Romeo Doubs to Injured Reserve The New England Patriots received a tough blow to their offense this week, with wide receiver Romeo Doubs landing on injured reserve due to a shoulder injury he suffered in the Patriots Week 6 win against the New York Jets. As the Patriots shuffle their roster, fantasy managers must quickly adapt to how these changes affect target distribution in New England's high-powered attack. The #Patriots placed WR Romeo Doubs (shoulder) on injured reserve and signed DB Elliott Davison to the 53-man roster. Doubs will miss a minimum of four games. Pats lose another starter to IR. - Evan Lazar (@ezlazar) October 19, 2026 With a minimum four-game absence mandated by an injured reserve stint, Doubs is guaranteed to miss time well past the mid-season threshold, putting his earliest potential return around Week 11. For fantasy managers dealing with tight bench space or multiple bye weeks, Doubs can safely be dropped in standard formats. While he carved out a meaningful deep-threat and red-zone role early in the year, losing a month and a half of availability makes him an unnecessary luxury to stash unless you have deep IR slots available. Fantasy Football Implications on Patriots Offense Oct 11, 2026; Foxborough, Massachusetts, USA; New England Patriots tight end Hunter Henry (85) reacts after catching an eleven-yard touchdown pass from quarterback Drake Maye (not pictured) against the Las Vegas Raiders during the second quarter at Lumen Field. Mandatory Credit: David Butler II-Imagn Images TPX IMAGES OF THE DAY | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Two Waiver Wire Priorities Emerge DeMario "Pop" Douglas is the undisputed winner in fantasy football value here, and will become a top Week 7 waiver wire priority for fantasy managers. Operating primarily out of the slot, Douglas is in line for an immediate bump in schemed touches, underneath routes, and third-down looks. He currently leads (or is tied for the lead) on the team in targets and touchdowns, and he should be rostered across all formats immediately. Hunter Henry also stands to pick up substantial intermediate and red-zone work with Doubs out of the picture. Tight end is a volatile landscape, and Henry's established chemistry with Maye makes him a premier waiver wire target and an immediate TE1 option at the position for as long as Doubs is out. The Stars Will Continue to Shine The impact on Drake Maye is relatively minor here. While losing an efficient target hurts overall depth, Maye's dual-threat dynamism and high-volume passing floor keep him firmly locked in as a weekly fantasy starter and QB1 with weekly QB1 overall upside. Expect an immediate spike in volume for A.J. Brown, as well. As Brown works his way back to full health, the vacated targets left by Doubs will funnel heavily toward New England's alpha wideout (as evidenced by the 10 targets Brown saw in his first game back after Doubs was injured). Brown was already a locked-in WR1, but his ceiling climbs even higher with fewer mouths to feed on the perimeter. Depth Pieces for Deeper Fantasy Leagues and Streaming Both Efton Chism and Kyle Williams will see an uptick in offensive snap counts as the team tries to replace Doubs' perimeter presence. Chism and Williams are worth monitoring in deeper leagues or dynasty formats, but they remain speculative adds for managers looking for streaming options until we see how the snap distribution shakes out on game day. Mack Hollins remains sidelined on injured reserve, meaning he won't provide immediate relief, though he could factor into the rotation later in the year once healthy. Meanwhile, backup tight end Eli Raridon will operate primarily as a blocking complement to Henry, keeping his fantasy outlook quiet barring an injury to the starter. He's started to see red zone looks over the last few weeks, and could be a sneaky tight end streaming option moving forward. item.title: LeBron James Could Make Unusual Decision Before 76ers Opener
item.description: NEW YORK, NEW YORK - OCTOBER 08: LeBron James #23 of the Philadelphia 76ers reacts during the second quarter of a preseason game against the Brooklyn Nets at Barclays Center on October 08, 2026 in the Brooklyn borough of New York City. NOTE TO USER: User expressly acknowledges and agrees that, by downloading and or using this photograph, User is consenting to terms and conditions of the Getty Images License Agreement. (Photo by Ishika Samant/Getty Images) Getty It has been said that LeBron James would’ve signed with the New York Knicks if they hadn’t won the 2026 NBA title. That’s an easy thing to say after the fact, and there’s no way to travel to an alternate timeline and see if it’s true. But regardless of the truth of it, the fact of the matter is that James will be at the Knicks’ season opener anyway — playing for the Philadelphia 76ers. James’ offseason decision ended with him choosing Philly, and that’s who the Knicks host on Tuesday night on the Opening Day of the 2026-27 NBA season. It’s a marquee matchup in so many ways, including the always intriguing NYC vs. Philly city clash, not to mention all the talent on the floor, and the fact that it’ll be James debuting with the 76ers. But at Madison Square Garden, it’ll also be ring night. The Knicks will raise their championship banner and give the title rings to each player before the game. That’s usually a scene that isn’t seen by the visiting team. James, though, is the rare player who might want to see it. And hey, he’s LeBron — he could probably do whatever he chooses in this situation. LeBron James Could Make Unusual Decision It would still be very odd to see James out on the floor watching the Knicks celebrate their championship. NBA insider Brian Windhorst, though, thinks it would at least make some sense when considering the entirety of who LeBron is. This is what Windhorst said on the Hoop Collective on Monday: “ LeBron has had four of his own ring nights of his own. And I know the Sixers won’t be out there on the court while the Knicks are accepting their rings and the banner goes up. But I wonder if LeBron would like to be out there just to feel the Garden. He’s praised the Garden 100 times and if you give him 100 more times he would praise it 100 more times. He truly loves the Garden. I wonder if part of him wants to just stand out there just as a fan of the game and as a fan of basketball.” James, as much as any player of this era, is regarded as someone who truly appreciates the history of the game. MSG is a historic venue, called “The Mecca” by those in the city. While it’d be surprising to see James out there on the floor, it’s fascinating to get some insight into his potential thinking from Windhorst, who has covered the King since high school. 76ers-Knicks Schedule These teams are scheduled for a 7 p.m. ET start on Tuesday. With the ring ceremony, the game itself likely won’t tip off at that time. But basketball fans in Philadelphia and New York City won’t mind a few extra

item.title: APM to Tinubu: You’re paying fuel subsidy through back door
item.description: By Luminous Jannamike The Allied People’s Movement (APM) has accused President Bola Tinubu’s administration of paying fuel subsidy through the back door, questioning the recent petrol price reduction despite the government’s declaration that subsidy was gone. The party also dismissed Finance Minister Taiwo Oyedele’s warning that restoring subsidy could push the naira to ₦4,000 per dollar, describing the projection as unfounded and accusing the government’s economic policies of driving businesses into closure. APM National Secretary, Ayodele Adebayo, stated this in a response to Vanguard’s inquiries, faulting the administration’s handling of fuel prices and its claims about investors’ loss of confidence in opposition parties. “What are they doing now with the current reduction in petrol price for one month? Is it not returning subsidy through the back door?” Adebayo asked. He argued that the naira had previously exchanged at a stronger rate, rejecting the minister’s projection as an attempt to justify the government’s position on subsidy. Adebayo also challenged Oyedele’s claim that investors had written off opposition parties as unserious, alleging that harsh economic policies had forced several companies to shut down. “Where are even the investors that the Minister of Finance, Taiwo Oyedele, is talking about? Is it the recycled ones by the present administration?” he queried. The APM secretary said his party favoured an appropriate pricing framework for petroleum products to prevent further hardship, insisting that Nigerians should not be left with little money after paying for fuel. “We cannot subscribe to seeing Nigerians use all their entitlements and earnings to buy fuel due to harsh economic policies,” Adebayo said. The post APM to Tinubu: You’re paying fuel subsidy through back door appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Packers reveal Josh Jacobs plan amid RB's potential Week 7 return
item.description: Packers reveal Josh Jacobs plan amid RB's potential Week 7 return originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Green Bay Packers got some huge news prior to their Week 6 matchup against the Dallas Cowboys , as it was revealed that Josh Jacobs would be activated off the NFL's Commissioner Exempt list on Monday after Week 6. Now that the day has come, there are plenty of questions about what Jacob's involvement in the Packers will look like going forward. He's not played in well over a month, so the questions about his workload are very real. Rob Domovsky of ESPN shared a big update on the Packers' plans with Jacobs, as Matt LaFleur revealed Green Bay won't have such a simple plan with Jacobs for Week 7. Packers reveal plan with Josh Jacobs amid return to NFL "Packers coach Matt LaFleur said Josh Jacobs will practice on Wednesday and get a full week of work but TBD on whether he'll play on Sunday at Detroit," Demovsky reports. The Packers are going to bring Jacobs up to speed with a full week of work at practice, which is an encouraging sign for Jacobs to return in Week 7. However, LaFleur revealed the team still might not play Jacobs in Week 7 against the Detroit Lions , even if he gets in a full week of work. LaFleur explained, "We feel like he's in a pretty good spot. He's been training, but he's missed the exposure to football." MORE : Aaron Rodgers blasts Buccaneers' field as 'one of the worst surfaces in the league' It seems likely that Green Bay will make him active if they believe he's ready for NFL contact, but if he's not ready to go, they're not afraid of making him a healthy scratch for a week. There is a big difference between working out and staying in shape for an NFL season versus being ready to take on big hits, like Jacobs will as a running back. Jacobs isn't a lock to play in Week 7, but the Packers are intent on working him into the offense during practice to see where he's at. If all goes well, then Jacobs might play. This plan from the Packers makes perfect sense. It's a long season, and sitting at 4-2, the Packers should have no reason to rush Jacobs back if he's not 100% ready to go. McCarthy surge Cam Skattebo's lack of rushing attempts is a major cause for concern for Giants

item.title: JJ McCarthy Shines in Relief, Could Start in Week 7: Fantasy Football Impact
item.description: New York Giants quarterback J.J. McCarthy (18) and New York Giants running back Tyrone Tracy Jr. (29) during a week 6 NFL football game between New York Giants and New Orleans Saints on Sunday, Oct. 18, 2026, at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, NJ. | USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect Jon Harbaugh and Fantasy Managers have some big decisions to make for the week ahead. Jameis Winston vs. JJ McCarthy will be a contentious subject as to who should get the starting job for Week 7 against the Texans and possibly going forward for the rest of the season. Let's dive into it. Winston Falters Against the Saints, McCarthy Steps Up New York Giants quarterback Jameis Winston (19) reacts after a false start penalty against the New Orleans Saints during the third quarter at MetLife Stadium. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect The Giants fell to the Saints on Sunday 34-27 in a game that had no lack for the dramatics. Winston started for the Giants and was unable to perform against the Saints defense. He threw for just 152 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions finishing the day with only 6.48 fantasy points. With 11 minutes and 25 seconds left in the fourth quarter, Harbaugh tapped Quarterback JJ McCarthy to take over under center and he did not disappoint. McCarthy completed 11 passes for 243 yards with a touchdown to Isaiah Likely. The Giants were down 34-10 when McCarthy checked in the game as he single-handedly propelled them back into the game where the Giants would eventually fall 34-27, coming down to the final pass of the game where Likely couldn't convert in the end zone to tie the game. HISTORY: JJ McCarthy came into the game with 11 minutes left and the Giants down 34-10. He cut the lead to 34-27 and nearly tied the game. He threw for 243 yards. The MOST in an 11 minute span in NFL HISTORY. WOW pic.twitter.com/EJ9tv5ZuIV - Polymarket Sports (@PolymarketSport) October 18, 2026 Even though McCarthy wasn't able to secure the win for the Giants, his performance was one for the history books. His 243 passing yards are the most ever by a Quarterback in an 11 minute span of an NFL game. He also tied Eli Manning for the Giants franchise record for the most passing yards ever in a single quarter. Coach Jon Harbaugh was asked at the podium who will be the starting quarterback for week 7 and responded with "Can't answer that right now." Wouldn't expect an immediate decision. Plenty to weigh over the next few days. https://t.co/gQ7mdhxJGu - Ian Rapoport (@RapSheet) October 19, 2026 Harbaugh is still weighing his options to announce his starting quarterback, but the official decision most likely won't come out for a couple of more days. However, given how good McCarthy looked and Winston's subpar performance it is believed that McCarthy will take over the starting job as soon as this coming Sunday. Fantasy Impact on the Giants Offense New York Giants quarterback J.J. McCarthy (18) throws a pass during the second half against the New Orleans Saints at MetLife Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Vincent Carchietta-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect With McCarthy likely to take over the starting job for the Giants, Fantasy Managers in need of a Quarterback (or currently starting Jameis Winston) should quickly look to pick up McCarthy off waivers ahead of Week 7. The Giants face off against the Texans on Sunday who have a top tier pass rush, but currently rank 27th in pass defense giving the young quarterback a good opportunity to keep his pass attempts high and continue to build his confidence in what would be his first start for the Giants. If McCarthy is named the starter, and can pick up where he left off against the Saints he will raise the ceiling for the Giants offense benefiting his two top targets Isaiah Likely and Malik Nabers in the process. Likely had six receptions for 99 yards and a touchdown in one quarter, all coming from McCarthy in his 11 minutes of relief in the fourth. Likely was JJ's top target along with Nabers who finished with 165 receiving yards with over half of them coming from McCarthy as well. The Giants also relied heavily on the pass game the whole game against the Saints, with McCarthy ending the game leading the team in rushing as well with just 26 yards. Cam Skattebo will most likely return to the rotation after posting zero attempts against the Saints, but the Giants run game is currently an uncertainty at best currently, suggesting a continuation of a pass first offense going forward. Fantasy managers should look to snag McCarthy while they still can, as he appears poised to take over the starting job. If he continues to build chemistry with Nabers and Likely, McCarthy could emerge as a legitimate fantasy difference maker going forward. item.title: Critic of Rwanda President Kagame beheaded in Uganda
item.description: A former Rwandan soldier living in Uganda, where he had become a vocal critic of his government back home, was found decapitated near Kampala, a police spokesperson said Monday. Rwandan authorities have been accused of assassinating opponents of President Paul Kagame, who has ruled the country with an iron fist since taking power in the aftermath of the 1994 genocide that claimed 800,000 lives, primarily among the Tutsi community. Robert Kabera, a former sergeant who fled Rwanda several years ago, was not outspoken during his time in the military but grew increasingly opposed to Kagame. His YouTube channel, “Major Robert TV”, which has 144,000 subscribers, included a song praising opposition figure Victoire Ingabire, a rare voice of dissent in Rwanda, who has been repeatedly imprisoned. Ugandan police said they were investigating the “murder of a male adult, (around 50), whose head was cut off, and up to now the head has not yet been recovered”, spokesperson Kituuma Rusoke told reporters on Monday, adding that the body had been identified by relatives as Robert Kabera. The body was found in Luwala, a village near Kampala, and the murder likely took place late on October 16 or early 17, he added. In Uganda, “Robert had no issues with anyone,” his brother, Victor Agaba, told AFP. “Our problem comes from home… The army created a criminal case against him. It was a witch hunt,” he said. Kabera was declared a fugitive after leaving Rwanda, and he was accused of corrupting a minor, which he denied. He is not the first opposition figure in exile to be assassinated. In 2021, a former lieutenant in the Rwandan army, Revocant Karemangingo, was shot dead in Mozambique, where he was suspected of secretly supporting an opposition force. Outspoken opponent Seif Bamporiki was gunned down in South Africa the same year, while a former Rwandan intelligence-chief-turned-critic, Patrick Karegeya, was strangled in his South African hotel room in 2014. Another exile, former general Faustin Kayumba Nyamwasa, who co-founded the Rwanda National Congress (RNC) opposition party with Karegeya, has survived several assassination attempts. AFP The post Critic of Rwanda President Kagame beheaded in Uganda appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Art crime detective Arthur Brand warns: 'All museums have been, and will be, victims of theft'
item.description: François Picard is pleased to welcome art crime detective Arthur Brand. "In the old days they stole a painting, but a painting is unique; you cannot cut it in two," explains Brand, "In the last 10 years they have been targeting more and more objects made of gold, silver". He examines the transformation of international art theft, warning that increasingly sophisticated criminal opportunism is shifting attention from irreplaceable paintings towards precious metals and gemstones that can be dismantled, melted down or dispersed.

item.title: All I want to hear in Rivers is Tinubu – Wike says in meeting with Fubara supporters
item.description: By Davies Iheamnachor Minister of the Federal Capital Territory and leader of the Rainbow Coalition, Nyesom Wike, has said that all he wants to hear in Rivers State is Bola Tinubu for a second term. Wike also declared that supporting President Bola Tinubu’s second-term bid is the strategic key to unlocking unprecedented political appointments, infrastructure development, and lasting national relevance for the oil-rich state. This came as the Minister had a strategic meeting with strong followers of the governor of the state, Sir Siminalayi Fubara, and Fubara-aligned Youth Leaders in Port Harcourt on Monday. This came less than 24 hours after he (Wike) led members of the State Assembly, Local Government Area Chairmen and Top leaders of the coalition to a closed-door meeting of top supporters of the governor at the private residence of Fubara in Port Harcourt. Addressing the meeting on Monday, Wike stressed that aligning with the federal government would secure the state’s position as a powerhouse in national politics. The Minister urged party faithful, youth groups, and stakeholders to put past grievances behind them, forgive past missteps, and rally solidly behind President Tinubu. Wike said: “All I want to hear in this state is Tinubu and nothing but Tinubu. If we play the role we are playing now, and we are one of the first three states that get the highest number of votes, we will get more of the appointments.” Wike noted that the current administration has broken records in terms of high-profile federal appointments awarded to indigenes of the state. He opined that a massive voter turnout for the President would guarantee even greater stakes and bumper opportunities for the state’s populace, particularly the youths. Wike, while reflecting on his political journey and stewardship, noted that his primary motivation is ensuring that the state remains a central fixture in national decision-making, where no president can afford to sideline the state’s leadership. He noted that local political structures across different platforms are collapsing into a unified front to back the President, adding that political transitions and alliances naturally come with friction, rumours, and minor disagreements Wike, however, called for calm and reconciliation at the grassroots level, assuring those who may have felt sidelined that structured reconciliation committees are working to ensure no genuine member of the family is left behind. He added: “We are talking for survival and growth. I am not going to be governor again; this is for your own interest. I want this state to grow. I want this state to play an important role in the politics of Nigeria.” Earlier, Mr Ezebunwo Ichemati, former Mayor of Port Harcourt, who spoke on behalf of the governor’s supporters, declared the readiness of the group to work closely with Wike to deliver Rivers to Tinubu and other candidates under the Rainbow Coalition. Ichemati said: “Every family has its own peculiarity in problems. What matters most is that the family comes together, the children watch what has divided them, and decide to move forward. “If today a marriage faces a problem, some children will go to their father, some will go to their mother. item.title: France riots: AI photos falsely depict elderly couple ‘stripped and robbed’
item.description: AI-generated photos falsely claiming to show an elderly couple being “stripped and robbed” during unrest in France have racked up millions of views. Amplified by far-right accounts, the images fuelled inflammatory claims about Muslims, Jews and the riots. The FRANCE 24 Observers traced one image to an AI photo montage published by a pro-Israel account. The images were created using OpenAI tools, and the alleged assault remains unverified, with no official reports confirming the attack.

item.title: They thought I’d be sleepy – Tinubu thanks ADC for keeping him awake
item.description: By Bayo Wahab President Bola Tinubu has taken a swipe at the African Democratic Congress (ADC), thanking the opposition party for keeping him awake as he addressed supporters of the CityBoy Movement and the Relax Tinubu Is Fixing Nigeria (RTIFN) group. “Some people thought by now I would be tired and sleepy since I arrived here on time, thank you ADC,” Tinubu said during a ceremonial meeting with the support groups in Abuja on Monday. The remark comes as Tinubu prepares for the 2027 presidential election, in which former Vice President Atiku Abubakar is the ADC’s presidential candidate. The President said the grassroots mobilisation efforts of the support groups would allow him to rest easy, expressing confidence in their reach and organisational structure. According to him, the CityBoy Movement had introduced a new approach to political mobilisation by building a network beyond the gathering of crowds at political events. “The CityBoy Movement, to all of you, you have done something new in Nigeria politics. You did not just gather people; you built a structure, millions of real, verifiable members,” he said. Tinubu highlighted the group’s claimed nationwide presence, saying its structure extended from the state level to local governments, wards and polling units. “You have a presence in every state, every local government, every ward, down to the polling units,” he said. The President also praised the group’s engagement with young Nigerians through its call centre and community outreach initiative, CityBoy Care. “You drilled down; a call centre that speaks to young Nigerians every day and listens to whatever their community needs. CityBoy Care, meeting members where they live,” Tinubu said. He described the movement’s activities as evidence of organised grassroots engagement, rather than publicity-driven mobilisation. Tinubu said the group’s efforts in reaching communities and responding to their needs had strengthened his confidence in its political mobilisation ahead of the next election. With the movement working at the grassroots, the President said, he could return home and “sleep soundly”. The post They thought I’d be sleepy – Tinubu thanks ADC for keeping him awake appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: National grid stabilised after ‘multiple trippings’ – NISO
item.description: The Nigerian Independent System Operator (NISO) says it has put in place corrective measures to stabilise the national grid following multiple trippings on Monday. The management of NISO said this on its verified X handle in Abuja. It said: “NISO wishes to inform the public that at approximately 12:40 p. m. on Monday, the grid experienced multiple trippings on the 330 kilovolt (kV) transmission network.” The system operator said that following the incident, it immediately implemented appropriate corrective measures to stabilise the power system and restore normal operations. It said that restoration efforts had been successfully completed, and the grid has returned to normal operation. ”NISO wishes to clarify that the incident affected only a section of the grid, contrary to unverified reports and claims currently circulating in the media, ” it said. According to NISO, members of the public are. therefore, advised to disregard misleading information and rely on official communication channels for accurate and verified updates on the status of the grid. It said that NISO remains committed to maintaining grid stability, ensuring the reliable operation of the national electricity transmission system, and providing timely and accurate information to the public. (NAN) The post National grid stabilised after ‘multiple trippings’ – NISO appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: D&D’s Dark Sun Creator Reveals Why the Controversial Setting Is ‘Not Political’
item.description: Dungeons & Dragons made good use of the concept of a multiverse before it became so obnoxious in entertainment. Every game of D&D can take place in a different world; many Dungeon Masters have fun creating their own, but for those who lack the time or inclination, there are plenty of settings to choose from. Ed Greenwood’s Forgotten Realms and Gary Gygax’s Greyhawk are usually considered the “classic” D&D settings, as they deliver on that flavor of fantasy that players expect from the game. But there are also more unusual choices that take D&D’s high fantasy premise in a whole different direction.

item.title: The X-Files Lego set is a wonderful bit of 90s sci-fi nostalgia
item.description: null Millennials get a lot of flak for being overly nostalgic, but I don't think that's fair. When the modern-day world has nothing to offer us but AI slop, shrinkflation and a sad acceptance that we can't be bothered to do anything about global warming. It's easy to see why we yearn for the days of Pogs, the Backstreet Boys, and Saved by the Bell. One area that we definitely had it good in the 90s was sci-fi , when legendary shows like Star Trek: The Next Generation, Stargate SG-1, and — of course — The X-Files ruled our TV screens long before the age of streaming services . You can relive those glory days of alien conspiracies, spooky happenings and cell phones the size of a brick with the Lego Ideas The X-Files set. This 1478 piece set is essentially two dioramas crammed into a single display piece. The top of the model depicts a spinning UFO floating above one of those iconic coniferous forests that dominated 90s sci-fi. Why? Because — thanks to some generous tax credits — it was cheaper to shoot in Vancouver, so that's where they all flocked. Disney Plus / Hulu bundle: was $12.99 now $11.99 Catch Mulder and Scully in every season of The X-Files on Hulu, which is available bundled with Disney+ for only $11.99/month for the first six months, then increasing to $12.99/month. View Deal Mulder and Scully closing in on our "Grey" alien friend in the woods. (Image credit: Future (Ian Stokes)) Beneath the woodland scene, though, is the real star of the show: Mulder's office, squirrelled away in the basement of the FBI's J. Edgar Hoover Building in Washington, D.C. This dingy little office is where Scully meets "Spooky Mulder", kicking off a glorious sci-fi odyssey that would last for eleven seasons (and two movies). Mulder's dingy little base of operations has been stunningly recreated here, with both overt references and subtle nods that X-Files fans will appreciate. The iconic "I want to believe" poster adorns the wall, alongside photographs of crop circles and a newspaper clipping from a paper called "The Lone Brickman" — a nice nod to " The Lone Gunmen ". There's even an actual X-File sitting on the desk, and a cute Lego spoof of the "Face on Mars", with a photo on the wall that shows a Lego head on the moon. The X-Files Complete Boxset: $160 Prefer to actually own your media? Make your way through this X-Files Complete Boxset on DVD. Just bear in mind that you will need a region-free DVD player to watch it with. The iconic "I Want To Believe" poster. Future (Ian Stokes) Newspaper clippings were a staple of the X-Files office. Edgar Hoover Building in Washington, D.C. This dingy little office is where Scully meets "Spooky Mulder", kicking off a glorious sci-fi odyssey that would last for eleven seasons (and two movies). The iconic "I want to believe" poster adorns the wall, alongside photographs of crop circles and a newspaper clipping from a paper called "The Lone Brickman" — a nice nod to " The Lone Gunmen ". Just bear in mind that you will need a region-free DVD player to watch it with. The iconic "I Want To Believe" poster. Future (Ian Stokes) Newspaper clippings were a staple of the X-Files office. Future (Ian Stokes) The show's legendary tagline is proudly displayed on the front. Future (Ian Stokes) X(Files) marks the spot. Future (Ian Stokes) It's been a hot minute since I watched The X-Files (that DVD box set beside my TV is calling to me), but even so, I had a blast building my way down memory lane, remembering episodes as I assembled the diorama. I love the little touches, like the display cabinets filled with artifacts, the VHS tapes scattered around the office and the black oil spillage on the floor. As with most Lego sets, the minifigures are half the joy. You get Mulder and Scully, obviously, with the dynamic duo of FBI agents both rocking flashlights (no smartphones with built-in lights back in the 90s). Mulder is wearing dark blue, while Scully is rocking an orangey brown suit, with both of them sporting an FBI badge. Outside of the principal pair, you also get Skinner, Mr X, and the Cigarette Smoking Man. Mulder's partner-turned-nemesis Alex Krycek also gets a suitably devious-looking minifig. It's the gloves, they just make him look like a bad man (which, to be fair, he is). Finally, to ramp up the paranormal scale, we also get a pair of monster minifigs: a grey alien and Flukeman minifigures. The grey alien was a must-have, especially given the UFO floating atop this display piece, but the one-off monster of the week, Flukeman, felt like a weird choice. Agents Mulder and Scully, FBI. Future (Ian Stokes) Assistant Director Skinner, Mr X, and the Cigarette Smoking Man in Mulder's Office. Future (Ian Stokes) Also, this John Doggett erasure will not stand. Sure, he could never replace Mulder, but Robert Patrick's seasons eight and nine run was excellent and he deserved a spot here. And while I'm voicing minor gripes, the usual Lego FOMO tricks were in force with this set; if you pre-ordered, you got an exclusive gift set — Scully's Lab — free of charge. This extra little diorama isn't necessary, but it does feel like the collection is incomplete without it and it's not for sale separately, so you'll have to try your luck with eBay scalpers if you want it. Speaking of Scully, Gillian Anderson has stated that after season 11 wrapped in 2018, she was done with the role. That wasn't entirely accurate, though, as she donned the lab gloves one more time for the Lego X-Files set advert . It's a short bit of fan service, but a nice touch, and, once again, it sparks those 90s neurons. All these delicious Member Berries come at a price, though, and that's the price. This blast from the past will set you back $199 (£179 in the UK). That's no small chunk of change. But then again, anyone who wants this set is in their thirties or forties and can probably afford that outlay for the nostalgia trip. And look at it this way: when The X-Files debuted back in 1993, the price would only have been about $86. I had a great time building the Lego X-Files set and if you're a fan of the series, you will too. Nostalgia often feels like a cheat code to our hearts, but there's nothing wrong with that. We deserve to remember the good times and the truth is that The X-Files was about as good as it ever got for sci-fi fans. You can buy the Lego X-Files set now, available for $199/£179 from the Lego store.

item.title: Subsidy removal: I’ve no regret, we can’t go back to Egypt — Tinubu
item.description: By Johnbosco Agbakwuru President Bola Tinubu on Monday said he had no regret over the removal of fuel subsidy, insisting that Nigeria cannot return to “Egypt.” President Tinubu also commended his son, Seyi, who is the Patron of the City Boy Movement, a political campaign structure for his re-election. The President spoke at a forum titled, “Together till 2027: An Evening with Original City Boy,” organised by the City Boy Movement in conjunction with the “Relax, Tinubu Is Fixing Nigeria” movement, at the Old Banquet Hall, Presidential Villa, Abuja. He said: “When I walked into this hall, I did not see a crowd. I saw Nigeria. I saw why I ran for the presidency of this country. I saw why I wake up every morning to work. I saw the reason. Now, I have no regret. I saw the future that belongs to you. “I cannot describe the situation or the elation I felt hearing from one or two of you. The words I do not often say enough, I must say tonight: thank you very much. Thank you for standing with me. The road we have walked these past three years has not been easy. “We took hard decisions that you heard from Kashim Shettima.” He continued: “I could listen to my political opponents promising a return to subsidy. Most of all, sometimes I remember my scripture studies, both in the Bible and the Holy Quran. When Moses left Egypt, they faced a challenge, and the Red Sea parted and gave way. “You cannot ask Moses to go back to Egypt. We wake up with ideas, original thoughts and deep thinking to move this country forward. With your energy and support, we will never go back to Egypt. “No regrets. Now, I have no regret. I saw the future that belongs to you. “I cannot describe the situation or the elation I felt hearing from one or two of you. The words I do not often say enough, I must say tonight: thank you very much. Thank you for standing with me. The road we have walked these past three years has not been easy. “We took hard decisions that you heard from Kashim Shettima.” He continued: “I could listen to my political opponents promising a return to subsidy. Most of all, sometimes I remember my scripture studies, both in the Bible and the Holy Quran. When Moses left Egypt, they faced a challenge, and the Red Sea parted and gave way. “You cannot ask Moses to go back to Egypt. We wake up with ideas, original thoughts and deep thinking to move this country forward. With your energy and support, we will never go back to Egypt. “No regrets. Before I left home, I saw one of the greatest Chinese economic news reports, that the economy was growing by about 4.6 per cent. We are on the right trajectory. We are in good company. The economy is growing steadily. You will have a future, a future to believe in. “Nigeria must win this election before any candidate does. You are not campaigning for me. You are campaigning for your own future, and that future is Renewed Hope. There is nothing that will push us back.” The President noted that when he took over the helm of affairs, there was no money to pay, and the country was owing airlines. “They were almost cutting their flights to Nigeria. Our foreign reserves were nothing. We were printing currency as if there was no tomorrow. But rather than looking back at the flaws of the past, I took the lesson. My first lesson was that I could not avoid assuming the responsibility and liabilities of my predecessor. That was a challenge. “We rebuilt our tax system. Many said young Nigerians would turn their backs on reform. They were wrong. You are here. I came and promised one thing: that I would stop the unending strikes by ASUU, the Academic Staff Union of Universities, so that a four-year course would be completed in four years in the universities. “We understood that a nation cannot borrow its way to greatness. You were patient when patience was hard. You defended this administration in the markets, on the campuses, in the motor parks and on social media. “Often, when it was not popular to do so, I saw it, I noticed it, and I will never forget it. I say thank you once again to the City Boy Movement. All of you have done something new in Nigerian politics. “You did not just gather people. You built a structure with millions of real, verifiable members, with a presence in every state, every local government, every ward, down to the polling unit. You built a call centre that speaks to young Nigerians every day and listens to whatever their communities need. City Boy Care reaches members where they live. “That is not noise. That is organisation. That is excellent thinking. That is the kind of seriousness this country needs from its young people, and I am very proud of you. I must say so. Relax: Tinubu is fixing Nigeria.” President Tinubu said the movement had carried its promise to every corner of the country and had told the story of the work his administration was doing when others chose to tell only half of it. “I say thanks to every youth support group at home and abroad — from Lagos to Maiduguri, from Karu and Akwanga to Sokoto, and from London to Houston to Toronto. You carry different names, different colours and different slogans. “No promise can be bigger than that of a better Nigeria — one Nigeria, united for one purpose, with great vision, commitment to duty, reality and fidelity to friendship. You have made an enormous contribution. I can go back home confidently tonight and sleep soundly.” The President assured the City Boy Movement, especially the youths who had stood with him, that they would not be left behind. “The future of this country does not belong to me, and it does not belong to my generation. It belongs to you. “I am very proud, once again, that when I signed the Student Loan Act, I had no regrets. Today, more than a million students have been supported through NELFUND.” On his son, Seyi, he said: “He is running after his father. Your young colleagues would have seen that you are investing your time effectively. We are with you. Thank you. You did it humbly. You did not ask for a title or an office. You went to the young people, your age mates, your group. You listened to them and organised them. “I am proud of all of you. But I will tell you what every father tells a son: you have only started. Do more, not less. Serve harder. Set an example that your own children, my grandchildren, will be proud to follow.” He advised the youths to ensure that every young person they knew had a Permanent Voter Card and used it. “Tell them what we have done, and tell them what we will do. Campaign with your ideas. I came and removed subsidy on my first day. No Nigerian will go bankrupt. Yes, there was nothing left to pay for subsidy.” The Vice President, Kashim Shettima, said Nigeria’s economy would have collapsed had President Tinubu not taken what he described as far-reaching decisions. He said that but for the tough decisions, critics would, by now, be writing epistles about a collapsed economy from the comfort of their homes in Dubai and New York. The Vice President credited the President’s decisions for the economy’s recovery. He said: “The President took those far-reaching decisions. He had the courage of conviction and the knowledge to take those far-reaching decisions that repositioned the Nigerian economy, so that now the economy grew by 4.43 per cent in the last quarter. “Most importantly, our foreign reserves are now hovering around the level of $60 billion. “Remember how far we have come. It is only those who have been in the deepest valley that will appreciate how magnificent it is to be on a mountain top.” To the critics of the administration, Shettima said: “The same people who are crying wolf — if the President had not taken those far-reaching decisions, wallahi, I am not talking to you as a politician; I am talking to you as a Nigerian — our economy would have collapsed. “These people, by now, would be writing epistles about a collapsed economy from the comfort of their homes in Dubai or New York, or in marriage with their young Moroccan wives. “I have not mentioned anybody’s name.” He admitted that Nigerians had endured hardship but said it could have been worse. “Your Excellency, distinguished ladies and gentlemen, the President has to be commended, not demonised. “Yes, Nigerians have gone through some tough times, but it could have been worse. “Be reassured that in the coming weeks, the President will come up with robust responses to agricultural challenges, and the prices of foodstuffs will certainly come down,” he stated. The Vice President said efforts were being made to reposition the economy, citing the Nigerian Education Loan Fund and investments in infrastructure. item.title: France faces reckoning with public order policing after violent protest weekend
item.description: France reeled Monday after a weekend of nationwide unrest sparked by mass protests against the rising cost of living and in support of high school students’ demands over education funding. In the violent clashes that erupted, law enforcement officers and protesters were wounded, public buildings were set ablaze and businesses were looted, raising significant questions about the French police's approach to public order.

item.title: Japan launches historic MMX sample-return mission to Mars' moon Phobos (video)
item.description: null Japan's groundbreaking mission to Mars is officially underway, headed to the Red Planet's mysterious moons Phobos and Deimos for a historic sample-return attempt. The Martian Moons eXploration (MMX) mission launched today (Oct. 19) from Tanegashima Space Center in Japan, riding an H3 rocket that lifted off from Pad-2 at Tanegashima's Yoshinobu Launch Complex at 3:41 p.m. EDT (1941 GMT; 4:41 a.m. local time in Japan on Oct. 20). The JAXA ( Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency )-led MMX mission is bound for Mars orbit, where it will study the planet's two moons, Phobos and Deimos. If everything goes according to plan, MMX will become the first spacecraft to land on and return samples from Phobos for study back on Earth, which scientists think could shed light on a decades-old mystery about the moons' origins and reveal clues about the formation of the early solar system . It was the 10th liftoff of Japan's expendable, two-stage H3 rocket, which was jointly developed by JAXA and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries. After clearing its launch pad today, the 207-foot-tall (63 meters) launch vehicle flew a nominal trajectory through its ascent corridor over the Pacific Ocean, jettisoning its four solid boosters in pairs just before the flight clock reached two minutes. The rocket shed its payload fairings about one minute and 20 seconds later, exposing MMX to the vacuum of space for the first time. H3's first stage is powered by two LE-9 rocket engines, channeling a mixture of liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen to produce a combined thrust of 331,000 pounds (1,471 kN), according to Mitsubishi Heavy Industries. As the mission clock approached T+5 minutes, H3 executed its main engine cut off procedure and separated from the second stage, which ignited its engines for a 5.5-minute burn about 10 seconds later. If all goes according to plan, the H3 upper stage will ignite its engine for a second time for a trans-Mars injection burn about one hour and four minutes after liftoff, a maneuver that will last roughly six minutes and 25 seconds. MMX will be released from the rocket's upper stage about one minute after the completion of that burn, while flying approximately 368 miles (592 kilometers) above central Africa. item.dc:creator: Josh Dinner
item.content:encoded: null Japan's groundbreaking mission to Mars is officially underway, headed to the Red Planet's mysterious moons Phobos and Deimos for a historic sample-return attempt. The Martian Moons eXploration (MMX) mission launched today (Oct. 19) from Tanegashima Space Center in Japan, riding an H3 rocket that lifted off from Pad-2 at Tanegashima's Yoshinobu Launch Complex at 3:41 p.m. EDT (1941 GMT; 4:41 a.m. local time in Japan on Oct. 20). The JAXA ( Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency )-led MMX mission is bound for Mars orbit, where it will study the planet's two moons, Phobos and Deimos. If everything goes according to plan, MMX will become the first spacecraft to land on and return samples from Phobos for study back on Earth, which scientists think could shed light on a decades-old mystery about the moons' origins and reveal clues about the formation of the early solar system . It was the 10th liftoff of Japan's expendable, two-stage H3 rocket, which was jointly developed by JAXA and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries. After clearing its launch pad today, the 207-foot-tall (63 meters) launch vehicle flew a nominal trajectory through its ascent corridor over the Pacific Ocean, jettisoning its four solid boosters in pairs just before the flight clock reached two minutes. The rocket shed its payload fairings about one minute and 20 seconds later, exposing MMX to the vacuum of space for the first time. H3's first stage is powered by two LE-9 rocket engines, channeling a mixture of liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen to produce a combined thrust of 331,000 pounds (1,471 kN), according to Mitsubishi Heavy Industries. As the mission clock approached T+5 minutes, H3 executed its main engine cut off procedure and separated from the second stage, which ignited its engines for a 5.5-minute burn about 10 seconds later. If all goes according to plan, the H3 upper stage will ignite its engine for a second time for a trans-Mars injection burn about one hour and four minutes after liftoff, a maneuver that will last roughly six minutes and 25 seconds. MMX will be released from the rocket's upper stage about one minute after the completion of that burn, while flying approximately 368 miles (592 kilometers) above central Africa. The MMX Propulsion Module (left) and Exploration and Return Modules (right), which together make up Japan’s Martian Moons eXploration (MMX) spacecraft, are seen at the Tanegashima Space Center in Minamitane, Kagoshima prefecture on Aug. 13, 2026. (Image credit: Yuichi Yamazaki/AFP via Getty Images) MMX will then be under its own power, and on trajectory for Mars. The interplanetary transit will last about 10 months, with the spacecraft scheduled to arrive at the Red Planet in August 2027. When it does, MMX's propulsion module will execute an orbital insertion burn to place itself in a quasi-satellite orbit (QSO) around Phobos, which places MMX within the space around the moon as both circle Mars. MMX will spend about three years in the Martian system, devoting much of that time to studying the 14-mile-wide (22 km) Phobos with its science instruments. The spacecraft also carries the IDEFIX rover, a joint effort of the space agencies of France and Germany, which is scheduled to deploy to the surface of Phobos in late 2028 or early 2029. After a mapping campaign to select suitable landing sites, MMX will perform two separate touchdowns on Phobos to collect and stow samples in the spacecraft's return capsule. Following its second landing and sample collection, MMX will briefly return to QSO with Phobos before transferring to a more elongated orbit around Mars that intersects with the planet's smaller moon, Deimos, which is just 8 miles (14 km) in diameter. During the last several months of its time around Mars, MMX will perform a series of Deimos flybys before departing for Earth in November 2030. If all goes according to plan, the MMX sample-return capsule will land in Australia in 2031. Scientists are counting on those samples, and other data collected during MMX's time around Mars, to answer a decades-old question surrounding the Martian moons' origins. Competing theories and conflicting evidence point to two possibilities for how Mars got its moons . Their near-circular, equatorial orbits suggest a narrative similar to how Earth's moon is thought to have formed — as a result of a massive planetary impact between Mars and some other giant space rock, which broke off pieces of the planet that eventually coalesced to form the natural satellites that orbit there today. A composite image with Mars and its two moons, Phobos and Deimos. (Image credit: NASA/JPL/University of Arizona) Neither Phobos nor Deimos is spherical, isntead; both are oblong and lumpy, like potatoes. That fact — along with their chemical composition, as far as we have been able to tell using telescopic spectroscopy — point to the possibility that Phobos and Deimos were asteroids from the early solar system that were captured by Mars' gravitational pull. Figuring out the moons' true origin story would provide key clues about Mars' geological past, the solar system's early history and the formation of the inner planets , mission team members have said. Once the MMX samples are safely returned to Earth, scientists will study their composition and mineralogy, then compare such chemical fingerprints with those of Martian rocks and asteroid material. These analyses, combined with data collected by MMX during its mission, will help nail down the origin of Phobos — and by extension, Deimos. — by While JAXA leads MMX, the mission is an international effort, with interagency partnerships between JAXA, NASA and the European Space Agency (ESA), as well as U.S. and European companies, which supplied a handful of the spacecraft's scientific hardware and communications equipment. NASA's contributions to MMX include the Mars-moon Exploration with Gamma rays and Neutrons (MEGANE, pronounced "meh-gah-nay") device, which is a gamma-ray and neutron spectrometer built by the Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory (APL); a Honeybee Robotics-built pneumatic sampler; and communications support using the agency's Deep Space Network. NASA has also invested approximately $87 million through the end of the mission, which includes funding for United States scientists and astromaterials experts on the MMX team. The agency is getting something concrete for such contributions: At least 15% of the planned 10-gram (0.35 ounces) returned Phobos sample will be reserved for NASA's study. Those materials will be transferred and maintained at the agency's Johnson Space Center in Houston for analysis and long-term preservation. MMX is not the first Phobos sample-return project to take flight, by the way. That distinction goes to Russia's Phobos-Grunt ("Phobos-Soil") mission, which launched in November 2011 but failed to get out of Earth orbit due to a rocket glitch. The 14.5-ton spacecraft eventually crashed back to Earth over the Pacific Ocean in January 2012.

item.title: ‘You Cannot Ask Moses To Go Back To Egypt,’ Tinubu Insists No Fuel Subsidy Return
item.description: President Bola Tinubu has reiterated that there will be no return to the fuel subsidy regime, insisting that his administration took a bold and necessary step to reform the country’s economy. Tinubu spoke on Monday during a meeting with the City Boy Movement, a youth-driven political and advocacy group founded to champion his administration’s agenda. “I came, and I removed the subsidy on my first day. Nigeria would have gone bankrupt; there was nothing left to pay for subsidies,” he said. “I could listen to my political opponents promising a return to subsidy.” Drawing a religious analogy, the president added, “I remember my scripture studies, both in the Bible and the Holy Quran. When Moses (Musa) left Egypt, the Red Sea parted and gave way. You cannot ask Moses to go back to Egypt. With your energy and support, we will never go back to Egypt.” The former Lagos State governor commended the organisation for drumming up support for his administration and urged members to take his government’s achievements to the grassroots. “Those of you who are lucky to work with me have given me all the answers needed and the confidence required to see the coming election as a simple matter,” Tinubu stated. “You will go to your campuses, your markets, and your villages. Make sure every young person you know has a PVC and uses it. Tell them what we have done and tell them what we will do. Campaign with your ideas.” President Tinubu announced an end to fuel subsidy during his inauguration in May 2023. The policy shift sparked an immediate hike in petrol pump prices, rising from under ₦200 per litre to current rates hovering between ₦1,350 and ₦1,405 per litre across major filling stations. While the policy has drawn widespread criticism over the heightened cost of living, the president remains firm on his stance. The federal government maintains that the decision is essential to reset the national economy, reassuring citizens that the initial economic hardship will ease over time. The post ‘You Cannot Ask Moses To Go Back To Egypt,’ Tinubu Insists No Fuel Subsidy Return appeared first on Channels Television .
